p: Jonathan's sake: Because of my oath and promise made to Jonathan, 1Sa 20:15.
kindness of God unto him: Such mercy as shall be acceptable to God.
Ammiel: Who was also called Eliam the father of Bathsheba, David's wife.
a dead dog as I am: Meaning, a despised person.
thy sons: Be ye provident overseers and governors of his lands, that they may be profitable.
As for Mephibosheth: That Mephibosheth may have all things at commandment, as becomes a king's son.
